text_block_list.text:
I team up with Мэдзиро Райан, an
Umamusume
dedicated to strength
training, and we decide to
take on the
Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан envies Мэдзиро МакКуин, the
most
talented racer in the Mejiro family,
and desires
nothing more than to beat
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With that goal in mind, we commence
our journey
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
